LESSON: READING 12.4.1 CLASS READER: MAIN IDEAS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do people read story books?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main ideas in the section read in the text
2. discuss the lessons learnt from the text

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main ideas in the section read in the text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main ideas in the section read in the text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. discuss the lessons learnt from the text
   In simple words: practise until you can discuss the lessons learnt from the text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas.
4. Show that you can: identify the main ideas in the section read in the text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 12.4.1 Class Reader: Main Ideas important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a section of the text aloud in turns and dramatise the events,
2. Discuss the main ideas in the sections read in the text in groups,
3. Relate the lessons learnt from the section read to real life experiences in groups,
4. Draw a chart showing the sequence of the main events in the section read,
5. Creativity and Imagination: It is developed as learners undertake group discussions and role-play to enhance creativity.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do people read story books?
2. What is the importance of reading a short story?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main ideas in the section read in the text
2. discuss the lessons learnt from the text

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
